subject: Re: Contrastive RL status - recommendation and scope cut
body:
Recommendation, going into the Jul 17 memo: adopt for state-based goal-conditioned tasks, hold on image.

The +8 points on state-based with no augmentation and no auxiliary loss is a real simplification win and I want it in the default agent config for Q3. Image-based, a 22-point seed swing is not something I can put in front of a customer, even with the temperature schedule cutting collapse rate to roughly 1 in 20.

Scope cut: we are dropping the third image environment from the memo entirely rather than reporting it half-measured. Hyun, please write the collapse analysis up as its own note - Eleni, this is the piece I think is genuinely publishable, separate from whether we adopt.

Deshawn, keep Carmen at 40% through the end of the window to finish the schedule ablation. Everything else winds down after the 17th.

Ulla
